cases.reference: BUT RECKONING TIME WHOSE MILLION'D ACCIDENTS CREEP IN TWIXT VOWS AND CHANGE DECREES OF KINGS TAN SACRED BEAUTY BLUNT THE SHARP'ST INTENTS DIVERT STRONG MINDS TO THE COURSE OF ALTERING THINGS ALAS WHY FEARING OF TIME'S TYRANNY MIGHT I NOT THEN SAY NOW I LOVE YOU BEST WHEN I WAS CERTAIN O'ER INCERTAINTY CROWNING THE PRESENT DOUBTING OF THE REST
cases.hf: But reckoning time, whose million accidents Creep in twisted vows, And change decrees of kings, Tan sacred beauty, blunt the sharpest intense, Diverts strong minds to the course of altering things. Alas, why fearing of time's tyranny, Might I not then say, Now I love you best, When I was certain or in certainty, Crowning the present, Doubting of the rest?
